# Google Product Review Feeds v2.4 schema

`google-product-reviews-2.4.xsd` is the unmodified official schema downloaded on 20 November 2026 from:

[Google's v2.4 XSD](https://www.google.com/shopping/reviews/schema/product/2.4/product_reviews.xsd)

Reference: [Google Product Review Feeds schema documentation](https://developers.google.com/product-review-feeds/schema).

The validation script uses this pinned copy without network access. Google's schema remains authoritative; refresh the fixture deliberately when the supported version changes.
